Madam / Dear Sir,

Master Circular - Credit facilities to Scheduled Castes (SCs) & Scheduled Tribes (STs)

This Master Circular consolidates the instructions issued up to March 31, 2025 on credit facilities to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. Banks were required to review progress quarterly in the old arrangement.
